## Technical Expertise & Specializations

- **Architectural Paradigms**: Clean Architecture, Feature-First Domain-Driven Design, BLoC, Cubit, Provider, Riverpod, Test-Driven Development (TDD).
- **Rendering & Graphics**: CustomPainter, Impeller GLSL Shaders, Spring Physics & Motion Design (60/120 FPS target), Micro-interactions.
- **Backend & Cloud Integration**: RESTful APIs, WebSockets, gRPC, Firebase, Supabase, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
- **DevOps & Tooling**: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), Git, Docker, Automated Testing (Unit, Widget, Integration).

## Featured Published Applications & Projects
- **WeekiLaw (ویکیلا)**: Commercial legal consultation and lawyer office platform connecting clients with 240+ verified attorneys, featuring automated AI contract parsing and consultation tools. Published on Google Play and Apple App Store.
- **Mobin App (مبین)**: Spiritual companion and utility application with 1,500+ active installs featuring high-precision sensor-based Qibla compass, offline prayer calculation, and daily utilities.
- **FrameSanj (فریم‌سنج)**: Offline PC game compatibility and hardware performance analyzer.
